testimonials.name: Local Family
testimonials.text: Last April, we had the opportunity to bring our family to Chiang Mai to send our eldest son (Ikhlas) to continue his studies. It was a great opportunity to take the family on a trip as well. Initially, like always, we planned to find simple accommodation and then go out to find halal restaurants. But this time, Malik introduced us to a place called Roof in Leaf Pool Villa. Upon arriving at the villa, we saw a wooden gate with a green sign. Opening the gate, the first feeling was like stepping out of the city into a garden. There were so many trees – large trees, ferns, vines, and smaller plants – everywhere you looked was green. It truly lived up to its name, Roof in Leaf, giving the feeling of a home hidden under the canopy of leaves.

testimonials.name: Sarah, UK
testimonials.text: I stayed for a month as a digital nomad. Fast WiFi, great community, and the meat shop is a bonus! The hostel was perfectly located near the mosque.

testimonials.name: Family from Jakarta
testimonials.text: Our family loved the villa. So peaceful and close to everything. The kids loved the pool and we appreciated the halal food options. Highly recommended!

testimonials.name: Darin From USA
testimonials.text: I visited this shop several times during my stay in Chiang Mai. The variety is impressive, from local sausages to fresh beef and chicken, and even samosas and sticky rice. The owners are incredibly welcoming, and their English is excellent. It's a must-visit for anyone looking for high-quality halal products in Chiang Mai.
